notes: Short-hand notes from AE/SE threads. POC focuses on: reserved capacity for night/weekend spikes (holiday volumes), deterministic routing when model fails (fallback rules to simpler reranker), tool-calling reliability (CRM write idempotency), transcript retention controls, and integration with their SAML SSO and internal observability.
